top_signals.title: Investor Pushes Snap to Raise Capital for New Specs Business
top_signals.summary: Hedge fund Blue Duck Capital Partners wants Snap Inc. to raise capital by selling a stake in its nascent Specs unit, putting additional investor pressure on the social media app to deliver on its big investment in augmented reality glasses.

top_signals.title: Preparing for a wider Union
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Strasbourg, 06 Oct 2026 The European Commission has adopted a package on pre-enlargement policy reviews, setting out the policy orientations and actions needed to prepare the Union for future enlargements. As announced by President von der Leyen in her 2023 State of the Union address and as mandated by the European Council, the measures proposed today prepare the Union's governance, policies and budget for enlargement, while strengthening the protection of the Union's values and the rule of law.

top_signals.title: Commission adopts proposal to accelerate standards development and improve EU competitiveness
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 06 Oct 2026 The European Commission has today proposed to modernise the European standardisation system to make it faster, increase the representation of small- and medium-sized enterprises, and to be better equipped to support the European Union's strategic interests.
